note: Original motion briefs for video or image-to-video tools and for human editors. This pack ships no generation API, no key, no endpoint and no bundled footage or audio. Storyboard text is original to Dezign0; no third-party storyboard or prompt text is reproduced.

storyboards.title: Hero loop, gradient drift
storyboards.useCase: Seamless background loop for a landing hero or section divider that already carries a static headline. Not for product UI: it shows no interface and earns its place only as atmosphere.
storyboards.format: 16:9 · 1920×1080 · 30 fps · MP4 (H.264) · seamless loop · no baked-in text

scenes.action: Gradient bloom enters from the lower-left; the peach band brightens by one stop while the top edge holds its value.
scenes.audio: low synth pad swelling, no transient

scenes.action: Paper-fibre grain parallaxes four pixels against the gradient; a second softer band crosses behind the first.
Drift decelerates and the composition returns to the opening framing so the loop cuts clean on frame one.
scenes.audio: pad resolves to silence inside the last four frames

storyboards.title: Empty state to populated list
storyboards.useCase: Short mobile product clip for onboarding, a feature announcement or a docs embed. The transition must also exist in the product itself; if the real UI cannot do it in code, this is a marketing film and must be labelled as one.
storyboards.format: 9:16 · 1080×1920 · 30 fps · MP4 (H.264) · one-shot · UI copy captured from the product, never retyped

scenes.action: Empty state holds: headline, one line of explanation, primary button. No cursor, no highlighting. Hold long enough to read both lines.
scenes.onScreenText: none — use the product's own empty-state copy
scenes.audio: room tone, one soft button press at 0:02

scenes.action: The button compresses one pixel and releases; three skeleton rows replace the empty state and shimmer left to right.
scenes.audio: single click, then a soft shimmer loop

scenes.action: Rows populate in a staggered sequence at eighty-millisecond intervals; each row fades in and rises four pixels into place.
scenes.audio: six light ticks in rhythm with the rows

scenes.action: One row expands to reveal its detail line while the rest hold still. End on the populated state with no motion for the last second.
scenes.audio: pad fades out under the final second

storyboards.title: Before / after wipe
storyboards.useCase: Redesign case study or changelog entry where two states must be compared in place. Use only when both frames exist at the same viewport and content; a wipe across different copy misleads.
storyboards.format: 16:9 · 1920×1080 · 30 fps · MP4 (H.264) · one-shot · before/after labels typeset in the edit

scenes.action: Before frame holds and drifts two pixels to stay alive; no cursor and no highlight.
scenes.onScreenText: Before — small label, lower-left, set in the edit

scenes.action: A vertical wipe travels left to right over four hundred milliseconds with ease-out, revealing the after frame beneath it; the seam keeps a one-pixel soft edge.
scenes.onScreenText: After — appears at lower-right as the wipe completes
scenes.audio: short whoosh on the wipe, soft impact on completion

scenes.action: After frame holds; one changed region lifts two pixels and settles to draw the eye, then everything is still.

storyboards.title: Dashboard tour, slow pan
storyboards.useCase: Product tour on a homepage or in a sales deck where a dashboard can be shown at full size. Use a real capture of the dashboard, not a redrawn mock, so the clip cannot claim features the product lacks.
storyboards.format: 16:9 · 1920×1080 · 30 fps · MP4 (H.264) · one-shot · no baked-in text

scenes.action: Tour opens on the top row of KPI cards moving at constant speed; cards pass through frame with no focus changes or zooms.
scenes.audio: steady pulse, about ninety beats per minute

scenes.action: The chart region enters; its line draws itself once over the first two seconds of the pass and then holds.
scenes.audio: pulse continues with faint data ticks

scenes.action: Camera settles on a single widget cell, revealing label, metric and trend; the cell brightens by two percent against its neighbours.
scenes.audio: pulse thins to a single tone

scenes.action: Pull back to the full dashboard and decelerate to rest, leaving the right third clear for an end card added in the edit.
scenes.audio: tone resolves, tail silence before the cut

storyboards.title: Shape-assembly sting
storyboards.useCase: Four-second opener or end card for a social clip or a documentation video. Use only with a mark that is already final; a sting built on a placeholder logo will need a re-edit.
storyboards.format: 1:1 · 1080×1080 · 30 fps · MP4 (H.264) · one-shot · no baked-in text

scenes.action: A single rounded square enters from below, overshoots six pixels and settles dead centre.
Two half-circles slide in from opposite edges and lock into the square's notches; the assembly overshoots four pixels before settling.
scenes.audio: two clicks one hundred and twenty milliseconds apart

scenes.action: The assembled mark holds; a rust accent sweeps across it once, then the frame is still for the last eight frames before the cut.
